name: snowflow-monorepo
description: SNOWFLOW open-world foundation — client (Babylon/WebGPU) + Colyseus server + shared contracts

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snowflow/shared && npm run build -w @snowflow/client && npm run build -w @snowflow/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @snowflow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @snowflow/server
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rimraf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist
